focus_areas: Geometric rigidity of the binder covers (depth map validation).
Structural connectivity of the metal ring mechanism (topology audit).
Legibility and coherence of text on the document insert (OCR audit).
Spatial localization of binder components (detection priors).
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the text on the paper inside the binder; AI models often fail to render coherent text in such small, constrained areas. Also, inspect the metal rings for any signs of 'melting' or inconsistent geometry, as these are common failure points in generated office supplies. Ensure the geometric depth auditor confirms the covers are flat and rigid, not warped like soft fabric.
image_description: An open green ring binder lying flat on a white surface. The left side shows the solid green interior cover, while the right side contains a document with text and graphics protected by a clear plastic sleeve. A metal ring mechanism connects the two halves.
